verdict.rationale: OpenCode's GitHub integration runs the agent remotely in a GitHub Actions runner when you mention /opencode. Asked to implement a feature, it works on a new branch and submits a PR with the changes for review. That covers the cloud 'build' and 'for my review' parts. Nothing in the evidence shows the agent running tests or producing a demo of the feature. missing for 10: documented automated test execution within the cloud run, demo artifacts (screenshots/video/preview deploy) of the built feature, independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end cloud runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.
Mention `/opencode` or `/oc` in your comment, and OpenCode will execute tasks within your GitHub Actions runner.
